title: Compress paired Gaussians to eight possible joint values
statement: For either ordinary pair over F_(2^d), gamma!=0 and any z, the alternating polar radical has k=0,2,4. The minus sum is (-1)^(d-k/2)*q*2^(k/2); the plus sum shares that magnitude or is zero at k=2,4. Thus at most eight joint states suffice at every residue degree.

body: Squaring the kernel equations gives a quartic system with invertible constant Jacobian and at most16 geometric roots. Alternation makes k even. Order-three invariance kills the radical restriction and fixes the minus Gaussian sign. These are source-exposed mechanisms, not an empirical state-count conjecture.
